description: Conversational recall: the most relevant, token-budgeted slice for a query. Default visibility is inheritance (memories at `scope` or an ancestor of it); optional scope_prefix flips to subtree-inclusive visibility.

scope_prefix.description: subtree filter: when present, candidates are memories whose scope equals the prefix or descends from it (same predicate as memory.erase/memory.coverage), replacing the inheritance filter; "" = every memory; omitted/null = inheritance behavior

name: memory.recall
